analysis.primaryGoal: Educate and support customers on how to handle busy periods without a Black Friday campaign at Westpack
analysis.audience: Westpack customers and subscribers preparing for the Black Friday period

visualStyle.imageStyle: candid staff photos, casual workplace scenes

reusablePatterns: Company values spotlight (no Black Friday but support during peak)
Personal stories from staff or customers
Step-by-step tips/guide linked as main CTA
Bright, playful palette with hand-drawn or informal lines
Multiple CTAs: guide link and related shop action
risks: Humorous/self-deprecating tone may not resonate with every B2B audience
Casual visual style may reduce perceived professionalism for some recipients
No direct product offer which may reduce immediate conversions

confidence.notes: Main body and buttons are clearly readable; subject and preheader are not visible.
